TREASURE CASE : 2019 T427. Description: A group of five (5) silver Roman coins of a denomination known as denarius dating to the period AD 69 - 117 (deposited after AD 114-7). Summary: No. Emperor. Date. RIC II ref. Qty. 1. Vespasian. AD 70. p.16, no.10. 1. 2. Vespasian. AD 69 - 70. p.16, no.15. 1. 3. Domitian. AD 88 - 89. p.170, no.138. 1. 4. Nerva. AD 97. p.225, no.29. 1. 5. Trajan. AD 114 - 117. p.268, no.338. 1. Catalogue: 1. A silver Roman denarius of Vespasian dating to the period AD 70 (Reece Period 4). COS ITER TR POT reverse type depicting Pax seated left holding branch and caduceus. Mint of Rome. Obverse description: Laureate head right. Obverse inscription: IMP CAESAR VESPASIANVS…
